summary: Helper function to compare the value of a PLIST_DATE node against a given number of seconds since epoch (UNIX timestamp).

name: plist_string_val_compare
signature: PLIST_API int plist_string_val_compare(plist_t strnode, const char* cmpval);
summary: Helper function to compare the value of a PLIST_STRING node against a given value. This function basically behaves like strcmp.

name: plist_string_val_compare_with_size
signature: PLIST_API int plist_string_val_compare_with_size(plist_t strnode, const char* cmpval, size_t n);
summary: Helper function to compare the value of a PLIST_STRING node against a given value, while not comparing more than n characters. This function basically behaves like strncmp.

name: plist_string_val_contains
signature: PLIST_API int plist_string_val_contains(plist_t strnode, const char* substr);
summary: Helper function to match a given substring in the value of a PLIST_STRING node.

name: plist_key_val_compare
signature: PLIST_API int plist_key_val_compare(plist_t keynode, const char* cmpval);
summary: Helper function to compare the value of a PLIST_KEY node against a given value. This function basically behaves like strcmp.

name: plist_key_val_compare_with_size
signature: PLIST_API int plist_key_val_compare_with_size(plist_t keynode, const char* cmpval, size_t n);
summary: Helper function to compare the value of a PLIST_KEY node against a given value, while not comparing more than n characters. This function basically behaves like strncmp.

name: plist_key_val_contains
signature: PLIST_API int plist_key_val_contains(plist_t keynode, const char* substr);
summary: Helper function to match a given substring in the value of a PLIST_KEY node.

name: plist_data_val_compare
signature: PLIST_API int plist_data_val_compare(plist_t datanode, const uint8_t* cmpval, size_t n);
summary: Helper function to compare the data of a PLIST_DATA node against a given blob and size. This function basically behaves like memcmp after making sure the size of the node's data value is equal to the size of cmpval (n), making this a "full match" comparison.

name: plist_data_val_compare_with_size
signature: PLIST_API int plist_data_val_compare_with_size(plist_t datanode, const uint8_t* cmpval, size_t n);
summary: Helper function to compare the data of a PLIST_DATA node against a given blob and size, while no more than n bytes are compared. This function basically behaves like memcmp after making sure the size of the node's data value is at least n, making this a "starts with" comparison.

name: plist_data_val_contains
signature: PLIST_API int plist_data_val_contains(plist_t datanode, const uint8_t* cmpval, size_t n);
summary: Helper function to match a given data blob within the value of a PLIST_DATA node.

name: plist_sort
summary: Sort all PLIST_DICT key/value pairs in a property list lexicographically by key. Recurses into the child nodes if necessary.

name: plist_mem_free
summary: Free memory allocated by relevant libplist API calls: - plist_to_xml() - plist_to_bin() - plist_get_key_val() - plist_get_string_val() - plist_get_data_val()

name: plist_set_debug
summary: Set debug level for the format parsers. @note This function does nothing if libplist was not configured with --enable-debug .

name: libplist_version
summary: Returns a static string of the libplist version.

signature: PLIST_API plist_t plist_new_date(int32_t sec, int32_t usec);

name: plist_get_date_val
signature: PLIST_API void plist_get_date_val(plist_t node, int32_t * sec, int32_t * usec);

name: plist_set_date_val
